just_in.excerpt: As federal enforcement intensifies, acquirers are discovering that inherited workforce irregularities can tank transactions — pushing immigration due diligence from checklist item to deal-critical priority.

just_in.title: Instant Oats Dosa: A 15-Minute Breakfast That Skips the Overnight Fermentation
just_in.excerpt: This no-ferment oats dosa recipe swaps the traditional rice-and-dal batter for ground oats, rice flour, and curd — delivering crispy, protein-rich South Indian crepes in under 15 minutes.
just_in.image_caption: A crispy dosa served with coconut chutney and sambar, a staple of South Indian cuisine. Instant oats dosa offers a quick, fiber-rich alternative to the traditional fermented batter.
just_in.nri_angle: Oats dosa is ideal for Indians abroad since rolled oats and yogurt are easier to find than urad dal, and the recipe avoids fermentation that can fail in cold climates.

just_in.title: British Airways Probes Food Poisoning After All Three Pilots Fall Ill on Hyderabad Flight
just_in.excerpt: One first officer was incapacitated at 30,000 feet and put on oxygen during the 10-hour flight to Heathrow. The airline is now reviewing crew accommodation in Hyderabad after its pilots' union flagged dozens of prior hygiene complaints.
just_in.image_caption: A British Airways aircraft at London Heathrow Airport. The airline has launched an investigation after all three pilots on a Hyderabad-to-London flight fell ill with suspected food poisoning.
just_in.nri_angle: The incident affects the heavily used Hyderabad-London corridor, a key route connecting southern India's technology workforce with the UK.

just_in.title: Too Much Protein? These Warning Signs Say It's Time to Ease Up
just_in.excerpt: As protein-fortified products flood supermarket shelves and high-protein diets dominate social media, nutritionists warn that consistently exceeding your body's protein needs can cause real health problems — from kidney strain to unexplained weight gain.
just_in.image_caption: Protein supplements come in many forms including powders, bars, and shakes. Nutritionists warn that exceeding recommended daily intake can cause digestive and kidney issues.
just_in.nri_angle: Indian diaspora households increasingly adopting Western protein-heavy diets and supplements may be overshooting their needs, particularly when traditional Indian diets with dal, paneer, and legumes already provide adequate protein.

just_in.title: Wall Street Braces for Fed Rate Hold, but Rate Hike Talk Grows Louder
just_in.excerpt: All 104 economists in a Reuters poll expect the Federal Reserve to hold rates at its July 28-29 meeting, but a growing majority now sees the probability of a rate increase this year as high.

just_in.title: Fatty Liver Disease Now Affects One in Three Adults Worldwide — and Most Don't Know It
just_in.excerpt: The silent epidemic of metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease is surging globally, with India among the hardest-hit countries. New treatments and screening tools offer hope, but experts warn early detection remains critically low.
just_in.image_caption: Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) now affects an estimated one in three adults globally. Early detection through routine screening can prevent progression to cirrhosis.
just_in.nri_angle: South Asian populations face heightened risk due to genetic susceptibility to insulin resistance and metabolic syndrome at lower BMIs, making proactive liver screening essential for diaspora Indians.
